question: why is the forbidden city in china called the forbidden city
answer: The Forbidden City in China is called the Forbidden City because it is a direct translation of the Chinese name 紫禁城 (Zíjinchéng), which means "Purple Forbidden City." This name comes from the Chinese characters 紫 (zǐ) meaning "purple," 禁 (jìn) meaning "forbidden," and 城 (chéng) meaning "city." The term "forbidden" in this context refers to the fact that the city was off-limits to common people and foreigners, not to the ruling class.
